title: George and Amal Clooney 'thrilled' for 'timely' Navi Pillay Nobel Peace Prize win
summary: George and Amal Clooney on Friday hosted the annual Albie Awards in London, celebrating the event's honorees, as well as this year's Nobel Peace Prize winner Navi Pillay.
